semrushEvidence.querySet: 11 exact queries used for review remediation and high-risk boundary checks

observations.keyword: titanium dioxide pigment for solar module films
titanium dioxide for photovoltaic white film
UV resistant titanium dioxide for engineering plastics
low ion titanium dioxide for electrophoretic coatings
titanium dioxide pigment for automotive coatings
high purity titanium dioxide for functional materials

serpEvidence.finding: Applications is aligned with industrial application discovery. Uses is much broader and introduces consumer, health, cosmetics, nanotechnology, and general-reference intent.
The exact coatings query is dominated by manufacturer application pages and technical selection guides; the in-paint query is more informational.

representativeSources.title: Predicting Paint Properties from TiO2 Pigment Properties

queries.query: titanium dioxide pigment for engineering plastics
titanium dioxide LCP high temperature plastics

serpEvidence.finding: The broad plastics query is strongly commercial-investigative and supported by manufacturer application pages. High-temperature subqueries are much narrower and require resin qualification.
Masterbatch has clear supplier and product intent. Film-masterbatch results emphasize thin-film dispersion, opacity, workability, and weatherability, supporting a separate qualified detail cluster.
Polycarbonate has distinct product-grade results and thermal/color requirements, supporting a separate detail page.
Outdoor PVC has a distinct weathering and durability intent rather than only generic plastics pigmentation.

representativeSources.title: Ti-Pure Titanium Dioxide for Rigid PVC Applications

queries.query: UV resistant titanium dioxide engineering plastics
titanium dioxide pigment UV resistance plastics

serpEvidence.finding: Current sources recognize pigment-grade TiO2 as relevant to UV interaction and weatherability in plastics, but the query must specify plastics to avoid coatings and nano-UV-blocker intent.

representativeSources.title: Role of Titanium Dioxide Pigments in Polymer Degradation and Stabilisation

serpEvidence.finding: The cluster is narrow and mixed between ingredient/technical pages and suppliers. Category and Detail require separate plural-family versus grade/evaluation language.

representativeSources.title: Siegwerk Ink Safety Portal: Titanium Dioxide

queries.query: titanium dioxide for laminated decorative paper

serpEvidence.finding: Paper is a valid broad category, while decorative paper and laminates overlap materially. The two Detail pages must be divided by base-paper/impregnation versus laminate-process validation.

Generic TiO2 solar-film queries frequently produce photoanodes, deposited TiO2 films, photocatalysis, and solar-cell research. The Site A pages must include white-film, backsheet, pigment, or EVA/POE qualifiers.

representativeSources.title: Optimization of Titanium Dioxide Film for Dye-Sensitized Solar Cells
representativeSources.type: primary research showing competing thin-film intent

representativeSources.title: Electrophoretic Deposition of TiO2 Coatings for Flexible Solar Cells
representativeSources.type: primary research showing competing photovoltaic intent

queries.query: high purity TiO2 MLCC electronic ceramics

serpEvidence.finding: High-purity TiO2 and MLCC/electronic-ceramic raw-material intent are clearly supported by current manufacturer pages.

representativeSources.title: Toho Titanium High Purity Titanium Dioxide

serpEvidence.finding: Electrophoretic TiO2 coating commonly means deposition of TiO2 films or nanoparticles. Low-ion, pigment, bath, or e-coat qualifiers are required for the intended paint formulation page.

representativeSources.title: Electrophoretic Deposition of Nanoscale TiO2
representativeSources.type: primary review showing competing deposition intent

representativeSources.title: Electrophoretic Deposition of TiO2 Nanoparticles
representativeSources.type: primary research showing competing deposition intent

queries.query: titanium dioxide for water based paint

serpEvidence.finding: Water-based paint has recognizable product and formulation intent. Waterborne coatings is broader and is retained as a supporting term.

representativeSources.title: Titanium Dioxide Pigment for Water-Based Systems

queries.query: titanium dioxide high PVC flat paint
TiO2 dry hiding high PVC paint

serpEvidence.finding: High-PVC flat paint has distinct formulation and dry-hiding intent. The Application page should own grade/application selection, while the Resource owns cost-reduction and how-to intent.

queries.query: titanium dioxide for waterborne automotive coatings

serpEvidence.finding: Automotive queries can mix conventional white pigment, transparent/microfine TiO2, and effect-pigment results. The main page therefore uses pigment as a qualifier; the waterborne page owns the system subtype.

Powder and coil are independently recognizable process/application intents. Powder has the stronger measured exact signal, so it owns the target query while coil remains a secondary cluster and split candidate.
Protective coatings is the best umbrella intent for the combined page. Marine and aerospace are narrower subapplications and remain supporting clusters.

Multi-purpose is established product terminology, most often for broad coatings coverage and sometimes multiple industries. The page must preserve separate qualification boundaries for coatings, inks, and plastics.

queries.query: high purity titanium dioxide functional materials
high purity titanium dioxide optical glass battery materials

serpEvidence.finding: Functional materials is a defensible umbrella only at category-like level. Optical glass and battery materials have different SERPs and qualification paths, making the combined Detail page a future split candidate.

representativeSources.title: Examining the Role of TiO2 in Oxide Glasses

serpEvidence.finding: The phrase is used as a commercial grade/application qualifier; results are supplier and technical-product oriented rather than general ink education.

serpQueryAudits.query: titanium dioxide pigment for solar module films

results.resultType: TiO2 product for solar backsheet films

serpQueryAudits.conclusion: Adding pigment + solar module films materially reduces thin-film/ETL ambiguity. The result set still skews technical and toward backsheets, so the category remains medium confidence and must describe polymer/module-film applications rather than deposited TiO2 films.
Soft PVC has the clearer commercial ownership. Solar backsheet remains a secondary topic within the frozen combined page; split if backsheet-specific impressions or content depth becomes material.

results.resultType: producer coatings guide with powder section

serpQueryAudits.conclusion: Powder coatings has the stronger TiO2-specific demand and owns the target query. Coil coatings is secondary and should split only if coil-specific demand or content depth justifies its own page.

serpQueryAudits.query: high purity titanium dioxide for functional materials
serpQueryAudits.conclusion: The umbrella term is broad and mixed. Keep low confidence because the frozen page combines optical glass and battery-material contexts; use the phrase as a topic, not an exact-copy requirement.

serpQueryAudits.query: low ion titanium dioxide for electrophoretic coatings
serpQueryAudits.conclusion: Low-ion qualification creates a defensible commercial sub-intent, but research on electrophoretic deposition remains strong. Keep medium confidence and clarify paint/coating-pigment context naturally.

serpQueryAudits.query: UV resistant titanium dioxide for engineering plastics
serpQueryAudits.conclusion: The intent is relevant but niche and mixed with transparent coatings/UV-stabilizer education. Keep medium confidence and use natural variants instead of exact-match repetition.
